claims.claim: The intake module and product_intelligence expose exactly SourceEvidenceIntakeError, SourceEvidenceInventory, and intake_product_source_evidence without additional public namespace or authority leakage.
SourceEvidenceInventory is frozen and contains exactly aligned manifest_paths and source_packs tuples populated with TASK-125 rehydration results.

Explicit exact-string roots are materialized once, resolved to bounded existing local directories, and recursively scanned only for regular files named exactly source_pack.json, failing closed for invalid or unsafe roots.
Manifest paths are canonical absolute strings; symlinks and out-of-root aliases fail closed, overlapping duplicates collapse, and configured limits bound the inventory.
Canonical path sorting makes manifest_paths and source_packs deterministic across root permutations and filesystem enumeration or creation order.
Each ordered manifest is passed exactly once to deserialize_product_source_pack; decoder failures propagate unchanged and intake returns no partial inventory.
Duplicate detection uses exact SourceObservationIdentity.from_pack equality, rejecting exact duplicate observations while preserving observations that share only partial identifiers.
Inventory values are directly consumable by existing M3 resolution and TASK-135 explicit-path APIs without intake invoking downstream resolution, admission, QA, provider, or product-truth logic.
TASK-138 performs only bounded read-only local discovery and rehydration, adding no writes, persistent stores, background work, network behavior, nondeterminism, or competing semantic authority.
The focused and compatibility regression coverage and documentation establish the P2 authority boundary and advance the roadmap to P3 without implementing P3.
